title: Dolphin holding a heart
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Dolphin body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="58" rx="30" ry="18" fill="#5bb8d4"/>
  <!-- Dolphin lighter belly -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="64" rx="22" ry="10" fill="#a8e4f0"/>
  <!-- Dolphin head -->
  <ellipse cx="72" cy="50" rx="16" ry="13" fill="#5bb8d4"/>
  <!-- Snout -->
  <ellipse cx="86" cy="52" rx="9" ry="5" fill="#5bb8d4"/>
  <!-- Snout tip lighter -->
  <ellipse cx="90" cy="52" rx="5" ry="3.5" fill="#a8e4f0"/>
  <!-- Eye -->
  <circle cx="78" cy="47" r="2.5" fill="#1a3a5a"/>
  <!-- Eye shine -->
  <circle cx="79" cy="46" r="1" fill="#e0f8ff"/>
  <!-- Dorsal fin -->
  <path d="M48 40 Q52 28 58 40 Z" fill="#3a9ab8"/>
  <!-- Tail fluke -->
  <path d="M20 58 Q10 48 8 54 Q10 58 16 60 Q10 62 8 66 Q10 72 20 62 Z" fill="#3a9ab8"/>
  <!-- Tail connector -->
  <ellipse cx="24" cy="58" rx="6" ry="8" fill="#5bb8d4"/>
  <!-- Pectoral fin -->
  <path d="M60 64 Q54 74 62 72 Q68 68 64 64 Z" fill="#3a9ab8"/>
  <!-- Heart held in flipper -->
  <g transform="translate(70,72)">
    <path d="M0 6 A5 5 0 0 1 10 6 A5 5 0 0 1 20 6 Q20 12 10 18 Q0 12 0 6 Z" fill="#ff4d6d"/>
    <path d="M4 3 A2.5 2.5 0 0 1 9 3" fill="none" stroke="#ffb3c1" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  </g>
  <!-- Small smile -->
  <path d="M82 54 Q85 57 88 54" fill="none" stroke="#2a7a98" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
